core_meaning.primary_meaning: Meryam is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Mary”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Meryam corresponds to the Arabic form مريم (Arabic مَرْيَم (Maryam)). Its core sense is mary; a female given name. Meryam is Arabic مَرْيَم (Maryam), the name of Mary, mother of Jesus, and a Qur'anic figure. The source gloss 'Mary, Mother of Jesus' is consistent. Same name as meriem and meryem.
